task: Combined PhysioMotion + BCI 59-channel EEG flow-matching pretraining
purpose: learn better EEG structure from more unlabeled EEG before supervised artifact segmentation

metadata.task: Version 2 channel-time binary EEG artifact segmentation
metadata.note: Scientific values are identical to the sharded dataset; only storage format changed for faster GPU training.

metadata.dataset_name: BCI Competition IV Data Set 1, 59-channel EEG windows for flow matching
metadata.downsampling_note: Every 4th sample is used to convert 1000 Hz to 250 Hz.

metadata.dataset_name: EEGMMIDB 59-channel EEG windows for flow matching
metadata.resampling_note: EEGMMIDB recordings are linearly interpolated to 250 Hz so each 10-second window has 2500 samples.

metadata.channel_selection_limitation: The first 59 stable EEGMMIDB EEG channels are selected to match the 59-channel model shape. This is used only for self-supervised EEG pretraining, not for supervised artifact-mask training.

metadata.dataset_name: DEAP curated 59-channel EEG windows for flow matching
metadata.resampling_note: DEAP is linearly interpolated from 128 Hz to 250 Hz.
metadata.curation_limitation: Only exact matching EEG channel names are placed into the 59-channel reference layout; other channels remain zero. Used only for flow pretraining.

metadata.dataset_name: CHB-MIT chb01 curated 59-channel EEG windows for flow matching
metadata.resampling_note: CHB-MIT is linearly interpolated from 256 Hz to 250 Hz.
metadata.curation_limitation: Bipolar CHB-MIT channels are slot-filled into the 59-channel tensor. Used only for flow pretraining.

holdout_excluded_from_flow_pretraining.subject: sub-30
holdout_excluded_from_flow_pretraining.reason: Avoid using the final supervised test run even during self-supervised pretraining.

objective: MSE between predicted velocity and x1 - x0
formula: x0 = Gaussian noise; x1 = real EEG; xt = (1 - t) * x0 + t * x1; target velocity = x1 - x0
